entry.title: Main :: RE: sonic the hedgehog sega sg-1000/sc-3000 demake sprites i did
entry.dc:creator: Maxim
entry.dc:subject: Main
entry.content:
Author: Maxim
Posted: Mon Nov 16, 2026 8:15 am (GMT 0)

Consider that SG-1000 sprites are 1-bit - you can only have more colours by overlaying them on top of each other, but then the sprite limit is also a limiting factor.

Then for the likes of Robotnik, you may instead use background tiles, but these can only have two colours per 8x1 sliver. Just converting things to the palette isn’t enough to fulfil the limitations of the hardware.

entry.title: Music :: RE: Ninja Gaiden (SMS) oddities
entry.dc:creator: Maxim
entry.dc:subject: Music
entry.content:
Author: Maxim
Posted: Sun Nov 15, 2026 6:06 pm (GMT 0)

Many games are subtly different between 50Hz and 60Hz but in this case I verified the timing is exactly 5:6 ratio and it’s unlikely there’s any difference from the old pack played at 83% speed. But as I had to do all the work to confirm it, I may as well upload both packs as per the logic above about where the game was released.
